program='''def transform(grid):
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 5 for v in row))
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or grid[r][c] == 5 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1, x), (y+1, x), (y, x-1), (y, x+1)):

                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        stack.append((yy, xx))

    lower = [(color, cells) for color, cells in comps if min(r for r, _ in cells) > divider]

def transform(grid):
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 5 for v in row))
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    seen = set()
    comps = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0 or grid[r][c] == 5 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            color = grid[r][c]
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1, x), (y+1, x), (y, x-1), (y, x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy, xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        stack.append((yy, xx))
            comps.append((color, cells))

    upper = [(color, cells) for color, cells in comps if max(r for r, _ in cells) < divider]
    lower = [(color, cells) for color, cells in comps if min(r for r, _ in cells) > divider]
    chosen_color, chosen = max(upper, key=lambda item: min(c for _, c in item[1]))
    _, target = max(lower, key=lambda item: min(r for r, _ in item[1]))

    out = [row[:] for row in grid[divider + 1:]]
    top_r = min(r for r, _ in target) - (divider + 1)
    left_c = min(c for _, c in target)
    src_top = min(r for r, _ in chosen)
    src_left = min(c for _, c in chosen)
    shape_h = max(r for r, _ in chosen) - src_top + 1
    for r, c in chosen:
        out[top_r - shape_h + 1 + (r - src_top), left_c + c - src_left] = chosen_color
    return out
